parameters.name: Sender
parameters.description: Phone number of the SMS sender.

parameters.name: Receiver
parameters.description: Phone number of the SMS receiver.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: Indicates the time an incoming SMS was received (when {{param|Status}} is {{enum|Received|Status}}) or when an outgoing SMS was sent (when {{param|Status}} is {{enum|Sent|Status}}).

parameters.name: StorageRef
parameters.description: Specifies the memory path where the messages are stored.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of the message.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Indicates the type of the message.

object.description: This object models individual SMS messages, including both received and sent entries.
